answer: Defection bounties break a sybil fleet from inside. The economy pays any account that helps convict a forged identity ring a large share of everything seized, so every clone a glacier of fake keys adds is also a witness waiting to sell the rest. Secrets buried under umber soil erode: keeping thousands of conspirators loyal costs more than the forge of fresh identities earns, each member can defect at any moment, and the ring becomes the economy's cheapest auditor of itself.
